title: 生体計測
subtitle: Biomedical Instrumentation
keywords: Department of Life and Applied Biosciences
educationalGoal:
In this department, you will learn about biology through not only classroom lectures but also laboratory subjects, and in your fourth year you will conduct research (PD3 program).
Therefore, in this course, you will learn the techniques (experimental equipment, measurement techniques, research materials, calculations for making reagents, etc.) that you need to know before you start your university life focused on experiments and research.
advice:
There are many things you need to do in preparation for carrying out specialized experiments and PD3 research. In this lecture, the lecturers of the department will
lecture on matters that will be useful for your future preparations, drawing on their perspectives and experience.
　
(1) Review of the knowledge required for biology
(2) Various types of measuring equipment
(3) Analysis of the data obtained and the significance of statistical processing: How to look at data?
(4) The importance of research samples
(5) How to write a biology report, how to read and use literature
requiredKnowledge: Please link related matters to what you are currently studying, including what you have studied in the Department of Applied Biosciences up to now.

activityGoals.body: To promote understanding of experimental equipment, measurement technology, and research materials
To acquire a solid understanding of calculations used in experiments and research on a daily basis, such as calc
Improve your report-writing skills and learn the techniques and tricks of writing that will be useful for PD3

achievementLevels.standard: Acquire knowledge of basic measurement systems, and be able to explain the basic matters related to each element of the measurement systems covered in class.
